claim_boundary: This one-acetone gas-phase MACE-MDP derivative audit tests only the frozen calculator's dipole/polarizability coordinate derivative path against central finite differences over all Cartesian nuclear components. It invokes no model energy, force, GTO/density source, PCM/continuum, experimental solvation label, fitting, calibration, or solvation prediction. A pass can admit only explicit frozen property-coefficient derivatives to later common-scalar force gates; it cannot certify a force, PES, runtime, or chemical accuracy.

candidate_identity.role: candidate frozen coordinate derivatives of moment-functional coefficients only
candidate_identity.strict_role_boundary: The audit never requests a MACE-MDP energy or force. It cannot infer an energy from property derivatives, and it does not make a direct MACE-MDP force a valid Route-2 force.

finite_difference_protocol.system: The frozen acetone geometry mobley_3867265 in route2-v0-qeq-acetone-qm-field-v1.json.
finite_difference_protocol.formula: dX/dR_Ai=[X(R+h e_Ai)-X(R-h e_Ai)]/(2h), with X the public MACE-MDP dipole or row-major flattened 3x3 polarizability.
finite_difference_protocol.analytic_interface: MACECalculator.get_dielectric_derivatives returns dmu/dR with shape (3,N,3) and dalpha/dR with shape (9,N,3).
finite_difference_protocol.translation_check: For a translation-invariant property, sum_A dX/dR_Ai must vanish for every output component and Cartesian i.

numerical_gates.interpretation: A failure rejects the frozen calculator derivative path as a coefficient derivative for this route. Do not change the finite-difference step, omit coordinates, smooth/symmetrize a derivative, add a force correction, or select an alternate property output after seeing the result.

decision_rule: If any numerical gate fails, reject the MACE-MDP property-coordinate derivative path for V0. Do not use it in an envelope force or compensate it with a fitted force/energy term. If all gates pass, admit only the derivative tensors as explicitly differentiated coefficients of a later independently defined moment/continuum scalar; a full KKT force must still include every c0, D, B, A, cavity, and gas-energy derivative and pass its own finite-difference/PES gates.
preexecution_disclosure: The installed MACE source was inspected to establish the public derivative interface and declared tensor shapes. No derivative or coordinate finite-difference calculation has been executed before this preregistration, and no numerical result selected the step or thresholds.
